question:
Which post by Harvey Motulsky has the most views? Please give the id and title of this post.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky'; the most views refer to MAX(ViewCount);

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_026 AS id, p.XCL_035 AS title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
WHERE u.XCL_055 = 'Harvey Motulsky'
ORDER BY p.XCL_031 DESC
LIMIT 1;
